source_brief_reference: Create a short educational explainer video about how an AI production pipeline checks generated frames before assembly. The video should be clear, practical, and suitable for beginners.
visual_intent: Educate viewer on what defects look like and why they matter
composition_requirements: Zoom into specific defects: bad cropping, distorted anatomy, color bleeding, missing elements with callout labels.
camera_framing_requirements: Close-up inspection view with magnifying glass effect
subject_object_requirements: Defect callout overlays on sample frames
required_assets: sample_frame_assets: defect example images, callout overlays
qa_criteria: defects clearly visible and labeled, examples representative
